tokens.name: folder
tokens.usage: Ground of every player screen: the open manila case folder. Holds ink (13:1), ink-muted (7.0:1) and stamp (6.3:1) text.

tokens.name: folder-deep
tokens.usage: CaseHeader, your own board posts, the earlier-clues drawer and disabled buttons. Holds ink (9.6:1), ink-muted (5.1:1) and bold stamp text 15px and up (4.5:1).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Every paper document: clue cards, board posts, polaroids, invite cards, inputs. Holds ink (16.7:1), ink-muted (8.9:1), stamp (8.0:1) and string (6.4:1).

tokens.name: rule-blue
tokens.usage: Index-card rules and the card's header line. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubble inside a message clue. Holds ink (13.8:1).

tokens.name: cork
tokens.usage: Ground of the Reveal board and the Host screen. Only ink text (8.3:1), and only on paper objects. The red string reads 3.2:1 here with its ink underlay.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text, control borders, avatars and the 3px focus ring on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on card (8.9:1), folder (7.0:1) and folder-deep (5.1:1). Never on cork (4.4:1).

tokens.name: stamp
tokens.usage: The one interactive color, rubber-stamp blue: primary buttons, links, today's day, stamps. On card 8.0:1, on folder 6.3:1.

tokens.name: on-stamp
tokens.usage: Text on stamp fills (8.0:1).

tokens.name: string
tokens.usage: The solution and nothing else: red string, pins, the GUILTY stamp. On card 6.4:1. Never for errors or decoration.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Highlighter behind today's new fact. Holds ink (11.9:1).

styles.name: case-title
styles.usage: Case title in CaseHeader and the Reveal verdict. Always uppercase.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Section headings on a screen. Always uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Read your clue, then post what you think on the board.
styles.usage: Everything the app says: board posts, help text, form fields.

styles.name: evidence
styles.sample: Someone in a dark jacket went into the kitchen around ten past eight.
styles.usage: Everything the case says: statements, receipts, messages.

styles.name: fact
styles.sample: Kitchen, 8:10–8:30 PM: one guest in a dark jacket
styles.usage: The structured fact under every clue, word for word from the solver.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Exhibit numbers, folder tabs, small labels. Always uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside tight pairs: a label and its fact, day segments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between lines of a document, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between board posts, avatar to post.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, card padding, gap between documents.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen, button side padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Bottom of long screens, Reveal board padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Receipts and torn paper.

tokens.name: radius-paper
tokens.usage: All paper and controls: cards, posts, buttons, inputs, stamps, folder tab.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles inside message clues only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars and pins.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: Every document lying on the folder or the cork.

tokens.name: shadow-lifted
tokens.usage: The culprit's polaroid after the reveal, anything being dragged.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Under primary and secondary buttons: a key that presses down 2px on tap.
